# Repository skill template

This is a format example, not an executable skill. Adapt it before saving it as `.skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md`; see [project skills](../../.skills/README.md) for the shared paths.

```markdown
---
name: sample
description: Describe the task and when this skill should be used.
---

# Sample Skill

Replace this paragraph with the task-specific procedure and verifiable completion criteria.
```
